package.description: FreeCellOK brings the popular FreeCell classic back to your Windows desktop.

en-US.description: FreeCellOK brings the popular FreeCell classic back to your Windows desktop.
en-US.longDescription: FreeCellOK brings the popular FreeCell classic back to your Windows desktop. Unlike traditional Solitaire, FreeCell is a pure strategy game where all cards are visible from the start and every game is winnable. Perfect for short breaks or longer thinking sessions.
en-US.name: FreeCellOK

zh-CN.description: FreeCellOK 将广受欢迎的空当接龙经典纸牌游戏带回您的 Windows 桌面。
zh-CN.longDescription: FreeCellOK 将广受欢迎的空当接龙经典纸牌游戏带回您的 Windows 桌面。与传统纸牌游戏不同，空当接龙是纯粹的策略游戏，所有纸牌从一开始就全部可见，每一局都可以取胜。无论是短暂休息还是长时间思考，都非常合适。
